author: TheOpAmerican
body:
I am posting this on the forums and sending it into the support e-mail for purpose of quicker response. I apologize if this is inconvenient and/or annoying.

Dear Avicus Staff,

Today I write to you with the intent of appealing or reducing a temporary ban imposed upon me by the moderator MidnightBeats for "Excessive infractions" on July 2nd, expiring on July 27th. I believe I have more than enough legitimate claims and arguments that may persuade you. With that, here it is. 

1) A few questionable infractions.
- "Do not use homophobic slurs" Warn by GalaxyBrit
Saying the word "gay" on it's lonesome in chat does not warrant an infraction, neither is it in any way homophobic.
- "Scamming" Kick by VennyMouse
I am not completely sure what happened here, but I was answering a new players questions about ranks and such when I was kicked, because I supposedly said "that you had to donate for staff". Ex-moderator Avy_21 paid witness to this.
- "Excessive Swearing/Rudeness" Tempban by Sulorak
I have a wholehearted belief that this was a very biased infraction. The only word anywhere near to being "Swearing" I said when I was banned; asshat. Does not warrant an infraction, at the most a verbal warning.
2) How many infractions I REALLY have?
I currently have 19 infractions at the time, including the tempban. However, with the infractions I have in question, that would equal 17 legitimate infractions. 
3) The privilege of other players; 
https://avicus.net/lmao_#infractions 
As seen in the link above, this player was allowed 26 infractions before being banned for the first time and successfully appealing. It was then 27 infractions when the player was banned, and given the message "DO NOT APPEAL, TOO MANY INFRACTIONS" , which was later APPEALED. 


I realize that I am not on a good path and that I need to change my ways if I would like to continue being a part of the Avicus Network community. I send this appeal letter with no harm or foul towards anyone, with hopeful forgiveness.

Sincerely,

 Jacob Sandobal

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello Jacob,

In the last couple of months you have received a number of infractions regarding chat misconduct. On top of that, you were warned, kicked and temporarily banned for similar reasons last year. The number of infractions indicates that you really need to improve your behaviour.

Your most recent infraction (https://avicus.net/infractions/621981) remains valid, and will not be appealed or shortened. Please wait until the expiry date, and make sure that you abide by the rules from now on. Keep in mind that If you continue this behaviour a permanent ban may be issued in the future.

Regards,
Mango_
